title: Excel Solutions
summary: A bilingual Excel tutorials and automation blog for accountants.
description: ExcelSolutionsV is the practice I founded in 2014 to help accountants in Mexico go beyond what commercial tax software offers, with custom data-extraction and automation tools. The blog publishes step-by-step tutorials on Excel and Python for tax professionals, including CFDI and SAT workflows, across automation, security, data analysis, data entry, and visualization. The current site is a MERN application (MongoDB, Express, React, Node.js); the first version, in 2019, was plain HTML, CSS, PHP, and SQL.

coverImage.alt: Excel Solutions blog home page: hero text, article categories and the latest posts

title: Pura Vida Vallarta Tours
summary: A bilingual tour-curation site for Puerto Vallarta and Bahia de Banderas.
description: Pura Vida Vallarta Tours curates the best tours and experiences around Bahia de Banderas so visitors do not have to guess which operator is worth booking. Bilingual (Spanish/English), video previews for each tour, and WhatsApp-based booking instead of a traditional checkout flow, matching how the target audience actually books travel in the region. Content is managed through Sanity.

coverImage.alt: Pura Vida Vallarta Tours home page with the hero headline over a coastline with seabirds

title: Bloom Aquatics
summary: A family business tracker for a small aquatic-plants and supplies shop.
description: A business tracker built for a family-run shop selling aquatic plants, secondhand articles, and supplies — inventory, sales, and day-to-day operations in one tool instead of scattered notebooks and spreadsheets.

title: La Estancia de Lupita
summary: A travel content site for Riviera Nayarit destinations.
description: An earlier React project — a travel site highlighting Riviera Nayarit destinations (La Peñita, Punta de Mita, Puerto Vallarta, the Marietas Islands) for a bungalow rental business.

coverImage.alt: La Estancia de Lupita home page: a Riviera Nayarit bay with the headline Your Journey, Your Story

title: Cover Studio
summary: A Python desktop app for generating branded cover images.
description: A desktop GUI (PySide6) for generating 16:9 cover images for Excel Solutions content: a background photo, a color band, a title, and an accent that wraps around it. Live preview updates as you adjust color, geometry, typography, and canvas; drag-to-reposition on the preview itself; saved presets for repeatable designs.

title: Crónicas del Vejerete
summary: A Spanish-language personal blog in the voice of a nostalgic, sarcastic old man.
description: Crónicas del Vejerete is a personal blog written in Spanish, in the voice of an old man who no longer believes anyone: chronicles of what was, what is, and what we were sold. It is a full Next.js application with its own writing and publishing tools, authentication, and a MongoDB content store.

coverImage.alt: Crónicas del Vejerete home page: the blog title in a serif typeface on a dark page, followed by the latest chronicles

title: Croquetas el Kilo
summary: An e-commerce site for pet food, sold by weight.
description: An e-commerce site selling pet food (Purina among the brands carried), rebuilt on Next.js and deployed on Vercel — its original Render-hosted version had gone offline before this rebuild.

coverImage.alt: Croquetas el Kilo home page: a bowl of pet food beside the headline Powered by Purina

title: FrutiApp
summary: An Android app that teaches kids basic math.
description: An Android app that teaches kids basic arithmetic — addition, subtraction, and similar operations — through simple, guided exercises.
